title: Freeze inputs and resolve active policy

completion: A bounded deletion ledger names the next highest-impact executable slices.

title: Freeze semantic and visual regression fixtures

work_to_retire: Vague correctness claims and tests that only prove zero error counters.

work_to_retire: Runtime source format decoding, invariant coefficient work and redundant immutable payloads for converted banks.

work_to_retire: Unnecessary whole-roster gameplay residency in previews and accidental cross-scene reservations.

stop_or_rollback: Any stale frame, cross-instance color leak or command-state dependency is a correctness failure even when geometry counts match.

title: Expand packets across native owners and special states
completion: Every required owner/variant has a complete native packet path and bounded independent instance state; unsupported legal combinations are not hidden behind pilot success.
work_to_retire: Live recording/immutable preparation across the converted owner set.
stop_or_rollback: One successful idle or CPU state does not close a fighter; missing special states block owner retirement.

title: Retire replaced renderer state and price the integrated path
completion: One authoritative native route remains for converted content, measured in the real shipped shape.
work_to_retire: Completed renderer migration’s old preparation/recording infrastructure and redundant storage.
stop_or_rollback: Retain no permanent old/new route pair solely for convenience; unconverted dependencies remain explicit and separate.

title: Prove duplicate-instance isolation and slot-sensitive behavior

stop_or_rollback: A kind-shared clock/patch, wrong directed outcome or unproved timing equivalence blocks the corresponding case; preserve immutable sharing where it is valid.

work_to_retire: Unknown float families and leaf-only conversion proposals; no speed saving yet.
stop_or_rollback: Unknown indirect targets remain blockers; do not declare zero runtime float from grep or the lack of FPU instructions.

title: Freeze units, ranges and numeric ABI

work_to_retire: Inconsistent numeric conventions and permanent float sandwiches.
stop_or_rollback: An unbounded source field requires a new representation or explicit admitted-domain proof, not guessed saturation.

completion: Primitives meet documented numeric semantics and target codegen obligations; speed is measured with their real callers.
work_to_retire: Software-float operations and redundant divides inside the selected fixed primitives.
stop_or_rollback: A primitive faster alone but slower after conversions/64-bit helpers is not adopted into the full chain.

title: Close residual camera, vector and transform chains
completion: Converted camera/transform producers and consumers are native end to end with no extra mirror.
work_to_retire: Residual mixed-representation camera/transform work, not the fixed route that already exists.
stop_or_rollback: A numerical error that changes clipping/attachment/depth behavior must be corrected before acceptance.

title: Migrate constants and target asset numerics
completion: Fixed constants/data arrive ready for native runtime consumption across converted domains.
work_to_retire: Load-time and per-use floating numeric conversion of host-convertible target assets.
stop_or_rollback: Do not edit extracted source or reference decomp to make the converter accept invalid inputs.

title: Build a no-float regression gate
completion: The checker distinguishes static data from arithmetic and detects all exercised negative patterns; domain migration is auditable.
work_to_retire: Future reintroduction of float and false success based only on helper-symbol disappearance.
stop_or_rollback: A finite trace or blacklist alone is insufficient proof; unresolved roots keep closure open.

title: Derive event lanes and timing semantics
completion: Every admitted speed/event regime has an explicit source-derived behavior contract and planned native representation.
work_to_retire: Unsupported assumptions about one global exact fixed clock.
stop_or_rollback: Do not remove the existing clock until its semantic replacements pass; a rational clock is not automatically source-equivalent.

completion: Native stepping passes the admitted semantic corpus and target-cost check; unresolved regimes remain explicitly open.
work_to_retire: Per-joint integer IEEE add/sub and repeated source wait arithmetic in qualified regimes.
stop_or_rollback: Do not pad every duration by one tick or silently keep binary32 under a new name. Failure requires case-specific redesign.

title: Compile compact fixed tracks and constant channels
completion: A compact resident representation replaces a named track path with measured whole-domain benefit.
work_to_retire: Repeated source track interpretation, invariant coefficient generation and inactive/constant work beyond the existing masks.
stop_or_rollback: Do not claim the already-landed live/run masks again; a larger bake that increases mandatory reads is rejected.

title: Create topology-owned required-joint closures
completion: Every required socket is current at its consumption tick with no dependence on whether the fighter was drawn.
work_to_retire: Repeated dependency discovery and unnecessary full hierarchy processing for gameplay consumers.
stop_or_rollback: Missing one ancestor or treating visibility as gameplay inactivity blocks the change.

title: Make native pose authoritative through the draw pilot
completion: Native pose drives the full pilot render chain with a net integrated improvement; legacy gameplay bridge is explicitly not final closure.
work_to_retire: Pose-to-render conversion sandwiches, duplicated visual pose authority and redundant copied transforms.
stop_or_rollback: A native evaluator with all old publication and rebuild work still running is not a completed pose slice.

title: Share local/world transform results correctly
completion: Transform counts scale with actual changed/required nodes and no gameplay result waits on GX readback.
work_to_retire: Duplicated CPU/GX hierarchy composition and whole-tree invalidation for unaffected work.

completion: All claimed families have semantic/runtime coverage; unimplemented content remains explicitly open.
work_to_retire: Remaining converted-family source pose/event parsing and representation conversion.
stop_or_rollback: A zero mismatch count over zero comparisons or untriggered state does not close a family.

completion: Native pose/event producers and all consumers agree on one representation, with the old bridge physically gone.
work_to_retire: Permanent duplicate pose/event authority and integer binary32 clock emulation in completed domains.
stop_or_rollback: Do not delete fields while a source-imported callback still consumes their float ABI; move that consumer first.

completion: A minimal hot-state schema and exact source-observation schedule are approved before runtime migration.
work_to_retire: Repeated cold-state access and unclear ordering/ABI assumptions; no early wholesale struct replacement.
stop_or_rollback: Do not assume all consumers can use one beginning-of-tick snapshot; missing writers block narrowing invalidation.

completion: The slice is native from its selected producer to publication and improves total caller cost with bridge cost included.
work_to_retire: Float operations and pointer-heavy state traversal in the complete movement/map-query slice.
stop_or_rollback: A visual approximation that changes land/ledge timing or a globally saturated overflow result is rejected.

title: Compile stage collision metadata and conservative candidates
completion: Generated metadata is complete and broad phase never excludes a source-valid contact in admitted domains.
work_to_retire: Repeated static line property calculation and unnecessary narrow queries for rejected geometry.
stop_or_rollback: Do not adopt a tree/bin structure whose setup/cache cost exceeds the small ordered scan or whose rounding drops contacts.

title: Convert interaction consumers and close gameplay pose bridges
completion: Gameplay consumers use native sockets/state and the converted domain no longer requires its legacy float pose authority.
work_to_retire: Pose-to-game float bridges and repeated broad facts in converted interactions.
stop_or_rollback: Shared-pair optimization cannot merge directed outcomes or reuse a snapshot after a stateful hit/status mutation.

title: Share AI query facts without changing CPU decisions
completion: Source-controller decisions match the specified discrete behavior and CPU cost is measured separately from its parent bucket.
work_to_retire: Repeated deterministic AI fact calculation and associated float/conversion chains.
stop_or_rollback: Four active GObjs with idle/no-op AI do not prove CPU engagement. Reject stale-phase shared facts even if average behavior looks similar.

completion: Active-set traversal is smaller/faster with identical ordering/lifetime semantics and no legal content capacity loss.
work_to_retire: Measured hot pointer/list discovery and unnecessary generic process overhead.
stop_or_rollback: Do not introduce an ECS/framework or swap-delete that changes gameplay processing order just to simplify code.

title: Evaluate scheduler flattening only when priced
completion: A retained scheduler is faster and mechanically equivalent, or a documented decision avoids an unhelpful rewrite.
work_to_retire: Only measured removable scheduling overhead; optional task may close as REJECTED_NOT_NEEDED with evidence.
stop_or_rollback: Any event/order mismatch or negligible removable cost ends this route; do not reengineer all scene management.

title: Expand fixed gameplay to all shipped domains
completion: Every shipped gameplay arithmetic root has a native implementation or remains an explicit final-closure blocker.
work_to_retire: Remaining gameplay float chains, old hot-state authority and conversion shims in claimed converted scope.
stop_or_rollback: Do not call a domain fixed because its typical state avoids an unmigrated special/cold callback.

title: Compile stage invariants and actor partitions
completion: The stage partition executes natively with complete content and a smaller hot preparation path.
work_to_retire: Per-frame source graph/material work for stage data that did not change.

completion: Each converted actor has a documented compact input contract and complete lifecycle proof.
work_to_retire: Repeated configuration and immutable vertex/material setup for simple native actors.

completion: Fixed particles preserve required event/state behavior with no reduced live population masquerading as optimization.

title: Build a compact native particle draw batch
completion: Batch preparation is smaller/faster and every required particle/telegraph remains represented correctly.

completion: All claimed UI surfaces are native/fixed with responsive source-consistent presentation.
work_to_retire: Repeated unchanged formatting/layout and residual mixed-representation UI preparation, not already-existing 2D optimizations.

completion: CPU wins do not cause hidden GPU overflow, stalls or content loss; limits and headroom are documented.
work_to_retire: Unnecessary graphics commands/overdraw only where equivalent native output is proved.

title: Retire converted stage/particle/UI compatibility paths
completion: Converted surfaces have one live native implementation and no hidden software composition route.
work_to_retire: Retired stage, particle and UI compatibility scaffolding and old float consumers.
stop_or_rollback: Do not use a broad file deletion to remove an untested required child state.

work_to_retire: Unclassified storage clients and repeated ownership guesses; no speed credit yet.

completion: A selected offload is safe and faster end to end; an unselected/failed route leaves no permanent framework.

completion: Services satisfy the owner’s runtime-fixed requirement, independently of battle-loop arithmetic.

completion: The owner’s fixed-runtime endpoint is structurally proved across shipped configurations, not inferred from one trace.
work_to_retire: All remaining runtime floating arithmetic and completed-domain compatibility dependencies.

completion: ITCM residents are explicitly justified by current measured benefit and all bytes fit.

title: Tune only remaining measured kernels
completion: Every kept tuning change has a mechanism, tests and integrated evidence.

title: Remove experimental routes and rebuild shipping shape
completion: The final binary, not just a routed experimental build, meets its current acceptance gates.
work_to_retire: Temporary dual implementations, experiment knobs and measurement-only dependencies from final runtime.

completion: No leaks/stale handles/late writers/underruns or unqualified scene gaps remain in the claimed shipped scope.

completion: Claimed shipped scope has complete native mechanics/presentation and fixed runtime without disguised IEEE helpers.

completion: A reproducible release artifact is covered by all required final gates.
work_to_retire: Accidental undeclared dependencies and false publication acceptance.
